header: Directly querying Amazon Security Lake data in OpenSearch Service
content:
Service
This section will walk you through the process of creating and conﬁguring a data source integration
in Amazon OpenSearch Service, enabling you to eﬃciently query and analyze your data stored in
Security Lake.
In the following pages, you'll learn how to set up a Security Lake direct-query data source, navigate
the necessary prerequisites, and follow step-by-step procedures using the AWS Management
Console.
